arguments.message:
Sure! When the authenticator app is reinstalled on a new phone, the old codes won’t work. To re‑enrol:

1. In Meridian, go to **Settings → Security → Two‑factor authentication**.
2. Choose **Reset**.
3. Scan the new QR code with the authenticator app on the new phone.
4. Enter the fresh six‑digit code the app generates to confirm.

If you can’t reach the settings page because you don’t have a working code, you can sign in with a saved recovery code from the original enrolment and then reset from there. After resetting, the old QR code is invalid and only the new one will generate valid codes.

Let me know if you need any more help!
